decisive_items: 50% to 90% diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD
polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during presyncope episode
response.rationale: Coronary angiography confirms multivessel obstructive coronary artery disease, and the polymorphic VT during syncope is consistent with ischemia-provoked arrhythmia. The normal EF and echocardiogram argue against cardiomyopathy, and a normal QTc excludes Long QT syndrome.

rejected.why: Echocardiography is normal with no LV hypertrophy; EF 58% is not a supportive HCM finding.
QTc is 403 ms, which is normal, so Long QT syndrome is not supported despite polymorphic VT.
No RV structural abnormality is described, and the ST-elevation pattern plus coronary stenoses better fit ischemia than ARVC.
